description: §2.9 S8 units on a labelled disposable PostgreSQL (each side's PostgresStore, one fresh migrated schema per case, durable rows read back): ResearchProgram.record_collection with its adoption reservation, ResearchProgram.fail_cycle with its recovery, FrontDesk.submit's request/session/outbox/event unit and the release evaluator's completion unit (releases.promote, the hook activation, the intent completed; the merge at depth 0); (a) injected failure at the unit's last write -> atomic rollback, (b) stale writer commits nothing, (c) replay adds no authority write, (d) the external effect entered at depth 0
